title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb/F]Tell me the old, old story, Of unseen things above,
[Bb/F]Of Jesus and His glory, Of Jesus and His love;
[Eb/Bb]Tell me [Bb]the story [Gm]simply, As to a [Bb]little child
[Bb]For I am weak and [F/A]weary, And helpless and defiled.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Bb/F]Tell me the old, old [F]story, tell me the [Bb]old, old story,
[Eb/Bb]Tell me the old, old [Bb]story, of Jesus and His love.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb/F]Tell me the story softly, with earnest tones and grave;
[Bb/F]Remember I'm the sinner whom Jesus came to save.
[Eb/Bb]Tell me [Bb]the story [Gm]always, if you would [Bb]really be,
[Bb]In any time of [F/A]trouble, a comforter to me.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb/F]Tell me the same old story when you have cause to fear
[Bb/F]That this world's empty glory is costing me too dear.
[Eb/Bb]Yes, and [Bb]when that world's [Gm]glory is dawning [Bb]on my soul,
[Bb]Tell me the old, old [F/A]story: "Christ Jesus makes thee whole."
